_README: Queue of C-02 vehicle floor bracket jobs for later execution by the local model. Each job has a GATE: it will not run until the required measurements exist. This is deliberate - hole spacing invented by a model produces brackets that do not fit, which is the single most expensive error this project can make.

_status_values.READY: all dimensions known - safe to generate
_status_values.BLOCKED_NEEDS_MEASUREMENT: cannot generate until someone measures the vehicle or sources an OEM diagram

_strategy_note: The 10 vehicle-specific brackets below are the literal answer to 'top 10 vehicles'. But see C-02-universal-ltrack.md first: designing to the L-TRACK standard (fixed 1.000in hole pitch, an actual published standard) collapses all 10 SKUs into ONE bracket. That is very likely the better business answer and it is buildable today with zero measurements. Treat the per-vehicle list as the fallback for customers who will not install L-track.
